AiAgent.title: SetuMoolya Farmer AI Advisor
AiAgent.subtitle: Your 24/7 intelligent farming assistant for crop protection, Mandi prices & profit planning
AiAgent.welcomeTitle: Namaste Farmer Friend! 🙏 How can I assist your farm today?
AiAgent.welcomeDesc: Ask agricultural questions in your preferred language, upload crop photographs for visual symptom diagnosis, explore verified APMC mandi prices, or compute net profits.
AiAgent.suggested1: Identify crop disease & symptoms from a photo
AiAgent.suggested3: How can I increase crop yield & soil health?
AiAgent.inputPlaceholder: Type your farming question, crop name, or ask for guidance…
AiAgent.uploadedPhotoMessage: I have uploaded a photograph of my crop. Please analyze it for possible diseases, pests, or nutrient deficiencies.
AiAgent.mandiPricesSubtitle: Verified national market rates based on Agmarknet & e-NAM data
AiAgent.marketDisclaimer: Prices represent modal APMC mandi auction ranges. Realization accounts for inter-state freight.
AiAgent.profitCalculatorSubtitle: Accurately compute net returns: Revenue = Quantity × Price | Net Profit = Revenue − Total Expenses
AiAgent.step1Desc: Your dedicated digital agronomist and crop market advisor, speaking your native language fluently.
AiAgent.step2Desc: Type any question regarding irrigation, fertilizers, weather, organic farming, or pest management.
AiAgent.step3Desc: Upload or click a photo of damaged leaves or stems to receive a structured pathology breakdown and preventive measures.
AiAgent.step4Desc: Tap the microphone icon to speak naturally in Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi, or English.
AiAgent.step5Desc: Every AI response includes audio speech controls. Tap 'Listen' to hear advice spoken aloud.
AiAgent.step6Desc: Switch tabs to explore APMC mandi rates, industrial uses, corporate buyers, and calculate your exact net crop profit.
AiAgent.errorGeneral: Could not generate AI advice. Please try again.
AiAgent.imageError: Could not analyze crop photo. Please verify the image file.
AiAgent.transcribeError: Voice transcription failed. Please try again or type your question.
AiAgent.micPermissionError: Microphone permission denied. Please allow microphone access in your browser settings.
